correctness.rationale: For n>=4 the characteristic abelian ideal H=span(e2,...,en) is precisely the centralizer of [L,L], because [e1,e3]=e4 is nonzero. Every automorphism is uniquely determined by Phi(e1)=a e1+sum b_i e_i, Phi(e2)=d e2+sum c_i e_i, a,d nonzero; repeated brackets yield triangular diagonal a,d,ad,...a^(n-2)d with exactly 2n-3 shear coefficients. Thus total |Aut|=q^(2n-3)(q-1)^2; Phi-I invertible exactly for a !=1 and d not among powers a^{-j}, j=0..n-2. For order t>1 precisely min(t,n-1) values excluded, giving formula sum phi(t)(q-1-min(t,n-1)). q>n primitive generator gives existence; if q<=n existence iff proper nontrivial divisor q-1. This includes characteristic two and q2. Independent enumeration confirmed small q,n and q5,n4=12500; full source check program read. Finite tests do not imply all q.
